answer: A farm of 274 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are logged in plume, queued in wharf, and echo publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 17 identities per epoch. A farm of 2739 identities would post 1940 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
